result.paraphrase: The XPG SX6000 Pro PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 SSD helps speed up booting, loading, and file transfers. Featuring NVMe 1.3 support and 3D NAND Flash, it delivers performance up to 4 times faster than SATA SSDs and offers capacities of up to 1TB. Its single-sided construction makes it thinner than standard M.2 2280 SSDs, improving compatibility. Ultra-fast PCIe Gen3x4 interface: read/write speeds up to 2100/1500MB/s; NVMe 1.3 support; 2nd generation 64-layer 3D NAND Flash; advanced LDPC ECC technology; HMB (Host Memory Buffer) and SLC caching.
